description.en: Dusk Lobbers are shadow plants that lob explosive buds down the lane. When powered Dusk Lobbers can lob buds down three lane.
description.zh: 幽暮投手沿着本行投掷炸裂性花蕾，也属于暗影植物。得到暗影能量时会沿着三行投掷。

chat.en: Lobbing comes easily for Dusk Lobber, but that's only because she's had extensive training and really enjoys parabolas.
chat.zh: 对幽暮投手来说，投掷很容易，但这只是因为她受过大量的训练，而且非常喜欢抛物线。

text.en: lob buds down 3 lanes when powered
text.zh: 得到暗影能量时能沿着三行投掷花蕾
